setup_fastcsp_logger: setup a FastCSP logger with configurable file and console handlers for centralized logging
print_fastcsp_header: print the FastCSP project header with optional restart info and stage list to the logger
log_config_pretty: log a configuration dictionary in pretty-printed JSON format to the FastCSP logger
get_fastcsp_logger: get or create a FastCSP logger from a config dict with optional root directory
log_error: log an error with its type and full traceback to the FastCSP logger
